details.biography:
Jacob's Well (first Keepers) · Seat 1, Front line

Six winters on the Boldock Wall taught you that the dark beyond the firelight is full of things that want in. You took the Keepers' coin to see the world past the Red Waste. You have never shared a fire with an orc and you are not sure you can start now.

Tonight: There is an orc chieftain in the common room, and the house rules say no fighting.
details.backgroundStory:
Abilities

Weapon Specialisation (Bind). +1 to attack rolls and +1 damage with blades, your longsword and dagger among them (already in their lines above). Weapon Training: once per round, as part of a hit with a blade, make a Disarm contest against the target (one rider per hit).

Combat Manoeuvres. You can use every manoeuvre in the Codex (Trip, Disarm, Shove, Shield Blow, Guard and the rest). Your own: Intimidating Strike, on a hit the target makes a Will save (DC 14) or is Frightened until the end of its next turn.

Manoeuvre Mastery. Manoeuvres that would give your own attack Disadvantage (Shield Blow) are rolled normally.

Battle Space. You count as flanking a creature whenever an ally is also in melee with it, not only from opposite sides.

Combat Reflexes (free feat). Once per round, an Attack of Opportunity against an enemy you can see that leaves your reach or moves past or through it. Disengage prevents it.

Toughness (Human bonus feat). +1 HP a level and +1 Constitution (both included), and Advantage on Constitution checks.

Shield Expert (feat, 1st). +1 AC with a shield (included), and your shield bonus adds to Reflex saves (included).

Mighty Deed of Arms (feat, 3rd). Once per round, call your shot and roll a d4 with the attack. On a hit and a 3 or 4: knock Prone, disarm, push 10ft, blind until the end of its next turn, or give it Disadvantage on its next attack. Save DC 14 (Fortitude for prone, push or disarm; Reflex for blind; Will for the penalty). A creature more than one size larger than you ignores the deed.

Kit: Boldock Wall Guard. Waste-Hardened: creatures with the Orc ancestry tag have Disadvantage on their first attack roll against you each round, and can't make you Frightened. Wall Authority: Advantage on Perception checks on watch or guard duty.

Human. Advantage on Tracking checks (chosen skill). You picked up Orcish on the Wall, listening to raiders across the ditch.

Armour Class on the sheet: Scale mail +4, Dex +1, wooden shield +1, Shield Expert +1

Class Abilities

1st Level

  • Weapon Specialisation: Choose one weapon group (see Weapon Training). You gain +1 to attack rolls and +1 damage with weapons of that group. You can change your group with one Downtime Phase of training.
    • 7th level: +2 to hit and damage. 15th level: +3.
  • Weapon Training: your weapon group gives you its own manoeuvre, used once per round as part of a hit with a weapon of that group (still one rider per hit). Every weapon's group is in the Group column of the weapon tables (the Shopkeeper's Catalogue and Basic Weapons in Character Creation); a magic weapon is in its base weapon's group, and for a weapon on no table the GM picks the closest group:
    • Bind (blades): make a Disarm contest against the target.
    • Hew (chopping and crushing): a creature your size or smaller makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC or is knocked Prone.
    • Hook (reach and tangling): make a Trip contest against the target, at your weapon's full reach.
    • Pinning Fire (missiles): the target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll. Thrown melee weapons (dagger, hand axe, spear) stay in their melee group.
    • Clinch (fist weapons): on a hit, make a Grapple contest against the target.
    • Shield Guard: instead of your group's manoeuvre, you may take this when you choose your group. While you carry a shield, once per round when you hit, the first attack against you or an adjacent ally before your next turn has Disadvantage.
  • Combat Manoeuvres: Every character can use every manoeuvre; the Fighter's edge is its own manoeuvres (Weapon Training, Armour Training, Fighter Manoeuvres) and Manoeuvre Mastery. See the Combat Manoeuvres section for details.
  • Combat Reflexes: You have the Combat Reflexes feat for free (see The Feats of Arneyan in Character Creation). It doesn't use a feat slot.
  • Kit: choose one (see Kits). Your kit reshapes one of the features above and improves at 9th level.

2nd Level

  • Manoeuvre Mastery: Manoeuvres that impose Disadvantage on your own attack roll (Shield Blow) are now rolled normally, with no Disadvantage.
    • 9th level: you learn the other two Fighter Manoeuvres.
    • 15th level: manoeuvres that would impose Disadvantage on your attack roll are rolled with Advantage instead.
  • Armour Training: you ignore the Cumbersome, Hot and Bulky traits and the Tower Shield's speed loss (Noisy still applies).
  • You also gain the Immovable manoeuvre: in medium or heavy armour, a creature no more than one size larger than you can't push or shove you, knock you Prone or otherwise move you against your will.
  • Once per round, out of turn, a creature that tries is knocked Prone instead.

3rd Level

  • Battle Space: you count as flanking a creature whenever an ally is also in melee with it, not only when directly opposite.
    • 15th level: +1 AC unless you wield a two-handed weapon, and a Flank Attack also pushes the target 5ft and deals +1 damage die.
  • Press the Advantage: once per round, when you hit with a melee attack, you may also make one contest manoeuvre (Trip, Disarm or Dirty Trick) against that creature as part of the hit.

4th Level

  • Fighter Manoeuvres: you learn two of the four Fighter Manoeuvres (see Combat Manoeuvres, below), and the other two at 9th. Each is used once per round, on a hit, and improves at 15th.

5th Level

  • Press On: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).
  • No Disadvantage if your first attack hit.
  • After the extra attack, you may make one Trip, Disarm or Dirty Trick contest, or one Fighter Manoeuvre if it hit, against the same target for free; it doesn't count as your once per round.

6th Level

  • Legend of Battle: Once per encounter, as part of the action you use to attack, your first attack that turn has Advantage and deals maximum damage if it hits, with no rolling.
    • 15th level: every attack that turn has Advantage and deals maximum damage if it hits.

7th Level

  • Unbroken: Once per day, when reduced to 0 HP or below, immediately stand at 1 HP. No save, no check.

8th Level

  • Hold Ground: Once per round, out of turn, when an enemy ends its move within your reach, you may move 5ft without provoking Attacks of Opportunity, and its first attack before your next turn has Disadvantage if you're now next to an ally.

10th Level

  • Combat Dominance: as your action, make one attack against each creature within your reach whose Level is no more than half yours. These attacks have no Advantage or Disadvantage from any source, and nothing adds an attack to them: no Press On, off-hand attack or Flowing Strikes.
    • 15th level: before each of these attacks you may step 5ft without provoking Attacks of Opportunity.
  • Renown: Name: your deeds are known. Title: Captain. You have Advantage on checks to recruit soldiers and mercenaries, who know your name. Your first follower, a man-at-arms, joins you.

13th Level

  • Sentinel's Watch: while you keep watch, the camp can't be surprised, and you need only half a night's sleep.

15th Level

  • Strength Bonus: Gain a permanent +1 to Strength. It can take the score past 20, to 22 at most (see The Mortal Limit in Character Creation).
  • Renown: Holding: you may found a barracks hall as your Holding (see Your Holding (15th) in Keeps & Kingdoms).
  • Weapon Specialisation, Manoeuvre Mastery, Battle Space, the Fighter Manoeuvres, Legend of Battle and Combat Dominance improve, as their entries say.

17th Level

  • Drillmaster: spend a season's downtime drilling your followers. One retainer or henchman gains a Level (still below yours), or one unit rises one experience tier (green, regular, seasoned, veteran, elite).

19th Level

  • Attribute Bonus: Gain a permanent +1 to either Strength or Dexterity. It can take the score past 20, to 22 at most (see The Mortal Limit in Character Creation).

20th Level

  • Legend of Battle (capstone): when you use Legend of Battle, it lasts 1 minute: every attack you make has Advantage and deals maximum damage if it hits, and enemies that can see you make a Will save against your Class Save DC at the start of each of their turns or are Frightened for 1 round.
  • Renown: Hold: You may found a keep or garrison (see Renown in The Arneyan Codex); each season 2d6 soldiers (Level 0) and one 1st-level Fighter join it. While you hold it, you have Drilled Ranks: an ally who trains for a week at your Hold knows one of your Fighter Manoeuvres while in your service.

Combat Manoeuvres

Every manoeuvre in the Combat Manoeuvres section is available to the Fighter from 1st level.

  • The Fighter also has manoeuvres of its own: a weapon manoeuvre (Weapon Training, 1st), Immovable (Armour Training, 2nd) and the four Fighter Manoeuvres below, two learned at 4th and the other two at 9th.
  • Each is used once per round, on a hit, and improves at 15th.
ManoeuvreEffect
Intimidating StrikeThe target makes a Will save or is Frightened until the end of its next turn. 15th: every enemy within 5ft of you saves.
Drive BackPush the target 5ft and step into the space it left. 15th: 10ft.
Bar the WayUntil your next turn, the target can't move past you without a Reflex save. 15th: nor can any enemy within 5ft of you.
Feint and StrikeYour next attack against the target this round has Advantage. 15th: so does an ally's next attack against it.

Kits

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Fighter folder. Drag one onto your character.

Choose one Kit at character creation.

  • Kits represent your fighting tradition, background, and the culture that forged you.
  • Each kit reshapes one of your 1st-level features, as its Reshapes line says, and improves at 9th level.
  • The peoples, orders and places a kit names are examples, not the only ones: a kit suits anyone from a tradition like it.

Taught on the Boldock Wall against the Red Waste, at Westfront Fort on the Wall, and on the walls of Gondural in Dul Khagul. You know what it costs to hold a line.

  • Reshapes: Hold the Line replaces Combat Reflexes.
  • Hold the Line: once per round, out of turn, when an enemy within your reach moves, it makes a Reflex save against your Class Save DC or its movement ends. You have Advantage on saves against fear while an ally is adjacent to you.
    • 9th level: an enemy whose movement you end also has Disadvantage on its next attack roll against anyone but you.
  • Wall Authority: Advantage on Perception checks during watch or guard duty, and recognised authority within the Boldock military.
